n: MENACE matchbox noughts and crosses machine
t: A matchbox machine and online simulator that learn to play noughts and crosses.
steps: Find the MENACE page by Scroggs.
Open the virtual MENACE in a web browser.
Play a few games to see how the beads change.
Choose the random or perfect opponent.
Look at the bead count graph after many games.
Decide whether to build the physical machine with 304 matchboxes.
Write your own lesson. The page gives none.
